summary: Backend-only review for LoL Autopicker v2.8.0 (desktop Tkinter tool). Ran full pytest suite under xvfb: 64/64 passed in ~36s, no segfaults. All features from the request are covered by tests and verified against spec: Setup.bat start+choice flow (static review, syntactically clean), ban/counter suggestion lists with sort/own rank-period settings, SuggestionList with ScrollFrame (>5 scrolls, <=5 no scroll, values always shown, no 'Werte an/aus' toggle), _load_ban_suggestions toggle+outside-click fold, scrollable SettingsWindow with update_btn/item_rates_btn/sections/width 324, LoadoutWindow confirm bar + STANDARD-BUILD items panel + item rates toggle, updater (installed/describe/version.json) and update_apply.apply preserves .venv & native_manifests. Live network check: fetch_build('Viego','jungle') returns items with start/core/item4-6; fetch_bans('jungle','all','30','winrate') returns 20 rows sorted strictly descending by winrate.
critical_code_review_comments: ui_layout.py is 1056 lines (>700 threshold). Consider splitting into submodules (ban-flow, counter-flow, DnD, hotkey handlers). Not blocking — tests pass — but increases maintenance cost as the overlay grows.

storage.clean_config: new keys ban_suggest/counter_suggest default to {'sort':'winrate','tier':'all','patch':'30'} / {'tier':'all','patch':'30'}; invalid 'sort' falls back to 'winrate'; show_item_rates defaults False and the removed 'show_rates' key is dropped. Verified by tests and by hand.

lolalytics.sort_tierlist: 'winrate' mode filters games<MIN_COUNTER_GAMES only when >=5 solid rows remain (prevents empty lists), 'banrate'/'pickrate' use raw rows; all sorts return at most SUGGESTION_MAX=30 rows. parse_items correctly drops empty item5/item6 and non-dict/non-list groups; counts default to 1 when start.count missing or length-mismatched. item_ids preserves order and deduplicates. format_games thresholds match '1.2 Mio.' / '56 Tsd.' / '900' expectation.
loadout clean path keeps imported=True only when strictly True (string 'yes' is dropped) — matches spec for ask_confirm/dirty detection.

updater.installed() returns {} when sha is missing/not-str; describe({}) shows 'unbekannt (manuell eingerichtet)'. update_apply.apply copies files, skips .venv/native_manifests/__pycache__, keeps old-only files in the install root (dirs_exist_ok=True + per-file copy) — regression-tested via module import under tmp_path.
updater.download rewrites every *.bat to CRLF before writing version.json — correct, cmd.exe mangles LF-only labels.

Setup.bat (static read): find_python probes py/python with tkinter+>=3.11 check and falls back to pinned Program Files/LocalAppData paths. Download/winget/refresh_path/goto labels wired correctly; choice /C JN /N with errorlevel 2 == N (skips install_browser.py) and errorlevel 1 == J runs it. :done label present. No syntax issues found.

SuggestionList caps max_height to the first 5 row heights only when len(rows)>VISIBLE, so <=5 items render without scroll; set_items('[]') shows 'Keine Vorschläge gefunden' via status label. Rows pass click through to on_pick when not taken; taken rows are dimmed and not clickable. These are all covered by test_bottom_padding_teammate_hint_and_suggestion_lists.
settings_layout.WIDTH=324 and win.geometry sets '324x400+x+y'; ScrollFrame installed on content frame; update_btn/item_rates_btn exposed as attributes used by the test suite.
No ObjectId/BLE catches outside the detached update_apply logger (which must swallow to keep the subprocess alive). All HTTP calls use SSL default context and bounded reads (6-64 MiB caps).

success_rate.backend: 100% (64/64 autopicker pytest + live Lolalytics fetch verified)
success_rate.frontend: n/a (desktop Tk app; no web UI)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests with: cd /app/autopicker && xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x1024x24' python3 -m pytest -q tests -p no:cacheprovider (expect 64 passed). For live fetches: python3 -c 'from lolpicker.lolalytics import fetch_build,fetch_bans; ...'. Tk tests must monkeypatch lolpicker.ui.fetch_build to avoid exit-time segfaults (see test_ban_borders_opacity_and_loadout_window). Windows-only pieces (Setup.bat, RegisterHotKey, LCU client, pythonw) can only be reviewed statically on Linux.
rca of the issue: N/A — all v2.8.0 features verified against spec with no regressions.
